prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2026-03-19. Act as a credit rating analyst.
| Current ratio           | 1.34 |
| Retained earnings       | 22,804M |
| Current liabilities     | 20,957M |
| Current assets          | 28,007M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 31,211M |
| Total liabilities       | 34,289M |
| Total assets            | 67,064M |
| EBIT / operating income | 2,494M |
| Revenue                 | 18,044M |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-03-19, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify). Choose exactly one label from: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company exhibits strong solvency with a total debt to total assets of 51.13% and a current ratio of 1.34, indicating good short-term liquidity. However, a relatively low EBIT to Revenue margin of 13.82% suggests moderate profitability and potential sensitivity to market changes, preventing a higher rating.

DECISION: A-
